chain-route-continuity.testName: Chain route continuity — a prerequisite holding slot cannot block the following ordered move
chain-route-continuity.regressionPurpose: A temporary holding slot must preserve the route for the following ordered main move.
chain-route-continuity.expectedHistoricalFailure: The pre-fix implementation cannot prove that the temporary holding state preserves access to the main target.

completed-chain-lifecycle.testName: Completed-chain lifecycle — a completed historical chain cannot poison a fresh order from current actual-state
completed-chain-lifecycle.regressionPurpose: A new graphical order must receive an identity distinct from a completed historical chain.
completed-chain-lifecycle.expectedHistoricalFailure: The pre-fix implementation reuses the historical chain id for the fresh order.

fresh-graphical-order-identity.testName: Fresh graphical order identity — a unique browser drag cannot bind to an older row only by vehicle and source
fresh-graphical-order-identity.regressionPurpose: A uniquely identified graphical order must not bind to or inherit lifecycle state from an older row with the same vehicle and source.
fresh-graphical-order-identity.expectedHistoricalFailure: The pre-fix implementation matches the fresh override to the legacy base row.

completed-chain-manual-return.testName: Completed-chain manual return — a valid local return remains quittable when canonical authority uses a separate outcome id
completed-chain-manual-return.regressionPurpose: A valid local return action key must remain authorized through the canonical authority alias.
completed-chain-manual-return.expectedHistoricalFailure: The pre-fix implementation rejects the local return card as replaced.

direct-wash-transit.testName: Direct wash transit — 4N to 10S uses the free wash corridor as one move instead of a trapped-egress chain
direct-wash-transit.regressionPurpose: A free, verified VN/VS corridor from 4N to southern butt tracks must remain a direct move and fail closed when any route resource is occupied.
direct-wash-transit.expectedHistoricalFailure: The pre-fix implementation has no authoritative direct-wash-transit route assessment.

inbound-trapped-target-history.testName: X2 — completed history cannot reject a new inbound order through a newly opened north end
inbound-trapped-target-history.regressionPurpose: Completed chain history must not prevent a new inbound release/main/return chain through a currently open north end.
inbound-trapped-target-history.expectedHistoricalFailure: The pre-fix implementation fails to materialize the new inbound three-step chain.
